correctness.rationale: Every k-tuple orbit is determined by the kernel of F_p^k -> F_p^d; every permitted extension kernel Kprime intersecting the original coordinate subspace at K and with codimension <=d is realized. Atomic diagrams record equality and ternary R, and the complete one-point-extension set recurrence exactly models the three-round EF game. A fresh RREF subspace enumerator classified p in {2,3,5,7,11,13,17}, d=1,2,3 into thirteen classes, matching stated finite boundary; this is exhaustive at those characteristics only. Universal p>=17 proof compares ten possible third-point affine expressions and thirteen exceptional slopes, whose pairwise cross-determinants are <=15; one generic scalar exists for every p>=17, and p=13,d>=2 has generic independent pair. The recurrence proves infinite stabilization, not extrapolation. Smallest-class representation from the complete table requires 121 for p=11,d>=2.
